response.consequence: No concrete failure from this change. The only side effect is that, after taking the write lock, concurrent callers each reload the manifest without re-checking the cache. This is a minor inefficiency, not a defect.
response.explanation: The change adds an RWMutex around the global cache. The signature and return values of GetWebAssets are unchanged. The cache is read under RLock, and writes happen under the full Lock. The cache is still returned when the environment is not Dev and the cached value is non-nil. The old code also stored nil in the cache on a read error, so that behaviour is not new. No caller or serialization mismatch shows up.
response.title: No API compatibility break from adding a mutex around the web assets cache
